entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:1
segments: ¶There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it [is] common among men:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:2
segments: A man to whom God has given riches and wealth and honor, so that he lacks nothing for himself of all he desires; yet God does not give him power to eat of it, but a foreigner consumes it. This [is] vanity, and it [is] an evil affliction.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:3
segments: If a man begets a hundred [children] and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not satisfied with goodness, or indeed he has no burial, I say [that] a stillborn child [is] better than he-

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:4
segments: for it comes in vanity and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:5
segments: Though it has not seen the sun or known [anything], this has more rest than that man,

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:6
segments: even if he lives a thousand years twice-but has not seen goodness. Do not all go to one place?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:7
segments: ¶All the labor of man [is] for his mouth, And yet the soul is not satisfied.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:8
segments: For what more has the wise [man] than the fool? What does the poor man have, Who knows [how] to walk before the living?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:9
segments: Better [is] the sight of the eyes than the wandering of desire. This also [is] vanity and grasping for the wind.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:10
segments: Whatever one is, he has been named already, For it is known that he [is] man; And he cannot contend with Him who is mightier than he.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:11
segments: ¶Since there are many things that increase vanity, How [is] man the better?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 6:12
segments: For who knows what [is] good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he passes like a shadow? Who can tell a man what will happen after him under the sun?
